title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep - June 2026
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for the cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML) on 2026-06-04. Quick reference for agenda, background, decisions we need, and follow-ups.

Meeting goals (high level):
- Align on north-star priorities for H2 2026: Hosted API reliability, Dedicated autoscaling, Optimize cost controls for embeddings-heavy workloads.
- Surface major risks/dependencies from Eng and Applied ML that would change priority order.
- Agree on a small set (3) of measurable milestones for Q3 to communicate to GTM and SRE.

Attendees (expected):
- Product: Aisha Kumar (owner), Maya Rodriguez (PM - Optimize)
- Eng: Ethan Park (serving runtime), Jonah Lee (platform), Priya Desai (sre - optional)
- Applied ML: Ravi Malhotra (model ops), Lin Wu (inference research)

Background / context to call out quickly:
- Recent infra cost spike in May attributed to embedding workloads (INF-342) — product asked for short-term mitigations vs long-term platform changes.
- Dedicated autoscaling beta: internal perf tests show ~12% throughput variance under burst scenarios (see PR #27). Need to decide rollout cadence.
- Customer asks: two enterprise customers asked for private deployment with stricter KMS controls; affects Private backlog.

Draft agenda (30-40m):
- 0-5m: Quick status updates (product priorities + one-liners from eng & applied-ml)
- 5-15m: Data dive: cost trends + embedding usage (product + finance summary) — Aisha to present top 3 cost drivers
- 15-25m: Engineering constraints & timelines (Ethan/Jonah) — dedicated autoscaling, KV cache improvements, control-plane changes for private deployments
- 25-35m: Applied ML impact & model-level mitigations (Ravi/Lin) — quantization/rep-config options, caching at model side
- 35-40m: Decisions & next steps: Agree on 3 milestones + owners + due dates

Pre-read / required data (please bring links or numbers into the call):
- Monthly token/embedding spend by customer tier (finance export) — Maya to attach latest if possible
- INF-342 perf logs + short summary (Ethan)
- Autoscaling beta results (PR #27) + canary plan (Jonah)

Open questions we should resolve in the meeting (priority order):
1) Short-term vs long-term for embedding cost: do we prioritize product-level quotas + billing incentives (2-4 weeks) or infra changes (KV caching + batching, ~8-12 weeks)?
2) Dedicated autoscaling: do we run a limited canary (10% traffic) for Dedicated customers in July or postpone to August after kernel-selection fixes?
3) Private/KMS asks: is this an immediate sales blocker (enterprise A) or can we triage into Q4? (need input from GTM)

Decision proposals (pre-written to speed meeting):
- Proposal A: Short-term: enable per-customer embedding rate-limits + recommendation workflow in Optimize (2 weeks). Long-term: prioritize KV prefix caching and model-side batching (track ETA 10 weeks). Owner: Product + Eng.
- Proposal B: Autoscaling canary in July at 10% with rollback hooks and extra monitoring (owner: Jonah; SRE support: Priya).
- Proposal C: Treat Private KMS requests as high-touch enterprise onboarding; fund a short scoping sprint in June, delivery target end of Q3.

Risks & unknowns (call out during sync):
- Kernel-selection perf regression on new CUDA drivers (affects autoscaling stability).
- Billing anomalies from delayed usage attribution — may skew short-term telemetry.
- Resource contention on Dedicated pools if canary traffic spikes unexpectedly.

Per-team asks / talking points (short):
- Product (Aisha/Maya): present cost data, propose prioritization rationale, synthesize customer asks into single backlog ticket that Eng/Applied-ML can estimate against.
- Eng (Ethan/Jonah): come with rough effort estimates (S/M/L) for: KV caching, batching improvements, autoscaling rollout steps, control-plane KMS changes. Highlight any blockers (driver/kernel, infra quotas).
- Applied ML (Ravi/Lin): advise on model-level mitigations (quantization, lower-precision embeddings, online distillation) and rough trade-offs for quality. Bring one small experiment suggestion that could drop embedding token cost without major retrain.

Follow-ups / action items to assign in meeting (template):
- Create a single cross-functional ticket for "Embedding cost mitigation (short + mid-term)" and attach cost numbers + customer examples. Owner: Product (Aisha). Due: 2026-06-11.
- Eng to surface "autoscaling canary plan" doc with rollback runbook. Owner: Jonah. Due: 2026-06-10.
- Applied ML to prototype lower-precision embedding for 1 pilot model and produce quality/latency delta. Owner: Ravi. Due: 2026-06-24.
- SRE to run load tests for Dedicated pool with canary traffic pattern and report possible pool contention. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-06-17.
- Customer Success to confirm whether Private/KMS request is blocking contract signature for Enterprise A. Owner: Elena (CS). Due: 2026-06-07 (ask during sync or follow up).

Notes to self / meeting facilitation reminders:
- Keep the discussion timeboxed to avoid deep technical digressions — flag deep dives as follow-ups and assign an owner.
- If disagreement on priority, use 3 quick vote buckets (now / next quarter / later) and capture rationale.
- Ask for concrete metrics (ETA, SLO impact, cost delta) before locking milestones.
- Capture decisions in Confluence page and link to the cross-functional ticket.

Draft language for the kickoff slide (one-liner):
- "Goal: Align on H2 priorities to reduce embedding unit cost and stabilize Dedicated autoscaling, with clear owners and measurable Q3 milestones."

Potential follow-up meeting cadence:
- Weekly 30m sync for next 6 weeks to monitor progress on assigned milestones (hosted by Product).

Stuff to add if we have extra time during call:
- Short demo / perf chart of autoscaling beta (Ethan)
- Quick customer quote on why Private/KMS matters (CS)

Unresolved (to bring up at end if still open):
- Which single milestone do we want to commit publicly by end of Q3? (we should not promise too much to GTM).

-- End of notes --

(quick TODO: attach INF-342 perf snapshot and May cost CSV before sharing doc)
